comparison.objective: Close a floor box without pinching its cord; the candidate sets an adjustable gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Cord routing/clearance while operating a lid, not precision threaded adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Box closes with the cord unpinched and undamaged; candidate requires stop angle, lock retention, and cycles.
comparison.reason: Safety around a routed cord is the tested ability, not jam-nut counterholding.
